main_text.p: Prep. עַל אֶל לְ ב, Niphal נִדְרַשׁ Requiri, Consuli, Repofci.
דָּשָׁא Herbascere. Ex Hiphil Fut. תְּדַשֵּׁא Herbascat, Gen.1.11.

דָּשַׁן Saginatus, Pinguefactus fuit. Pihel Pingue reddidit: item Decinera-vit, A cineribus purgavit, Cineres removit, vel Incineravit, id est, in cineres redegit. Pyhal דָּשַׁן Pinguefactus fuit. Anomalum, Pinguefiet, Jesa.34.6: ex Hophal & Hithpahel.
דָּת f. Lex, Edictum, jus. Chal. דָּת, Dan.7.25. וְדָתָא נִפְקַת Et sententia egrediebatur, Dan. 2.13.
דְּתָאָא f. Chald. Tenera herba, Dan.4.12: ex Hebreo דֶּשָׁא per commutationem ש in ת.
main_text.head: ה
main_text.p: הָא En, Ecce. Chald. הָא כְּדֵי Ecce sicut, Perinde ac, Dan.2.43. הָא idem. הבחר

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-style vocalised entries are transcribed as best legible; some vowel points are uncertain. The lower right fragment "הבחר" is a faint marginal or catchword-like mark and may be a signature.
